notes.title: ZombieZoid® Zenith Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
[list]
	[*] Added support to the Spanish language.
	[*] Frame rate improvements.
	[*] Various bug fixes.
	[*] New main menu.
	[*] All the pre-render cinematics were replace with in-game equivalents
	[*] Weapons can now be bought in stores.
	[*] The enemies will drop less items but more coins.
	[*] Since the enemies now drop more coins, the prices in stores have gone up.
	[*] Added more stores with more items throughout the maps.
	[*] Added victory celebrations when defeating a boss.
[/list]

notes.title: ZombieZoid® Zenith Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Our first steam patch has been released, here is the change log:

We have improved the English localization
Fixed a dynamic collision at "The Deserted Road"
Fixed a bug where a weapon animation would loop indefinitely
Fixed a bug that could prevent the HUD from updating the active weapon
